key_patterns: Queue: tools/main-prebuild-queue.mjs drainPreparationQueue holds a named-pipe queue lock, validates the full inventory (tickets/dispatches/results, canonical JSON via durableCreate/readQueueObject, schema asserted in ticketResult), and blocks all new work while any dispatched ticket has a missing/unknown/failed/blocked terminal without a valid resolution (preparation-resolution.mjs readPreparationResolution). A prepare() throw after dispatch is always recorded 'unknown'. Consumer: tools/publish-latest-main.mjs drainLatestMainQueue -> prepareLatestMainOnce (freezes source worktree into packet <target12>-<liveBinding8>-<django8> under config.releaseDirectory, deterministic name, asserts cache lock) -> runPublisher spawns <packet>/source/tools/publish-main.mjs --prepare-only --result-file <packet>/invocations/<uuid>.json; result file is written only on success; non-zero exit -> Error('本次目标发布未完成，退出码：N'). Native: tools/publish-main.mjs + tools/publish-prepared-main.mjs publishPreparedMain prepare-only path writes preparation/PREPARING.json, source-binding.json, worker-plan.json, PREPARED.json; on caught failure before publication writes preparation/FAILED-<uuid>.json; it holds the worker rotation pipe lock \\.\pipe\TERUISI.Worker.ReleaseRotation.v1 (tools/worker-local-release-rotation.mjs withRotationLock) for the whole preparation. Deploy (发布main.bat): runLatestMainCli deploy-ready -> acquireMainPublicationQueue (queue lock) -> prepareLatestMain -> observeLatestMain (recomputes packet name) -> deployReadyMain/inspectMainPreparation (needs PREPARED.json). Classifier: tools/release-scope-plan.mjs classifyRelease (tools/** -> full worker+django). Control bundle membership: tools/install-main-prebuild.mjs export controlFiles; bundles are installed from a clean committed source (prepareControlUpgrade asserts git status clean, binds sourceCommit). Code style: dense one-line-heavy ESM with assert/strict, canonical JSON, wx-flag durable creates, Chinese user-facing messages, English internal assertion messages.
